question: Who was the recipient of Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar 2017 for Kathak?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vidha Lal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vidha Lal **was the recipient of **Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar 2017 **for **Kathak**.
 
• The Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar is a yearly Indian honor presented by the Sangeet Natak Akademi to exceptional artists under 40 who have showcased their talent in music, dance, and drama. 
 
• It aims to offer national acknowledgment to artists in the initial stages of their careers. 
 
• Each year, up to 33 artists are chosen for this award, receiving a prize of ₹25,000. This award has been granted since 2006.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Jitendra Maharaj **was an Indian dancer and Kathak maestro, hailing from the Varanasi Gharana. He was honored with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award by the Government of India.
 
• **Rajendra Gangani, **renowned for his inventive style and technical expertise, is an Indian Kathak dancer. He is celebrated as one of the foremost proponents of the Jaipur Gharana style of Kathak.
 
• **Geetanjali Lal,** an accomplished Indian Kathak dancer and choreographer, was bestowed with the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award by the Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2007.
